svg.title: Anciaux shrinkers with minimal Legendrian leaves
svg.desc: Numerical closed or two-ended Anciaux profile, with a selectable projected two-dimensional slice of its Legendrian-torus product in ℂ³. The slice is not the full threefold. Homothetic time scaling is exact.
svg.text: Numerical ODE profile and projected immersion
Common spatial scale · teal: profile / slice · rust: second piece / asymptote · gray: reference geometry
